projects.title: Procurement HTE
projects.summary: Enterprise procurement system for Pertamina Subholding that automates procurement document generation, approval tracking, and vendor management.
projects.problem: PT Patra Drilling Contractor (Pertamina Subholding) faced a manual, time-consuming procurement process. Each procurement stage required different documents created from scratch, leading to format inconsistencies and approval delays.
projects.solution: A web-based Procurement HTE system was built with automatic document generation per stage, multi-level approval workflow, and integrated vendor management. The system enables procurement teams to create, review, and approve documents in a single platform.
projects.impact: Document creation time was significantly reduced. Document formats became uniform across all stages. The approval process became transparent with clear audit trails.

projects.title: Vannamei Shrimp Expert System
projects.summary: Knowledge-based expert system for vannamei shrimp disease diagnosis using Naive Bayes and Certainty Factor methods — supporting academic research.
projects.problem: Manual diagnosis of vannamei shrimp diseases requires high expertise and lengthy processes. Farmers and researchers struggle to identify diseases based on symptoms without a knowledge-based system.
projects.solution: An expert system was developed using Naive Bayes for disease classification and Certainty Factor to measure diagnostic confidence. The system accepts symptom input, processes the knowledge base, and produces diagnosis with confidence levels.
projects.impact: Researchers can perform more structured and faster diagnostic analysis. The system output supports decision-making and serves as a reference for further aquaculture research.

projects.title: Pomeng Chatbot
projects.summary: AI assistant guide helping patients & visitors access hospital service information — doctor schedules, clinic locations, outpatient procedures.
projects.problem: RS Prima Inti Medika needed a system to help patients and visitors quickly access service information — doctor schedules, clinic locations, outpatient procedures — without queuing at the information desk.
projects.solution: An AI-powered Pomeng Chatbot integrated with WhatsApp was built. The chatbot can answer common hospital service questions, provide location guidance, and automatically direct users to relevant information.
projects.impact: Information desk workload decreased as repetitive questions are handled by the chatbot. Patients get information faster without waiting. Staff can focus on more complex inquiries.
